artworks.title: Der Kauffman (The Merchant)
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy harbor scene with cargo and sacks in the foreground, ships in the background, and stylized clouds in the sky. The ships are detailed with wooden textures, masts, and flags. The drawing has a historical appearance and the title "Der Kauffman" implies a focus on trade or mercantile activity.

artworks.title: Der Kuniginn (The Queen)
artworks.artist: Hans Lützelburger after Hans Holbein the Younger
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with three full-length figures and a partial figure in the background. A central figure is dressed in an ornate gown with puffed sleeves and a cinched waist, embellished with a necklace and a crown on her head. Her facial expression suggests movement or surprise. Her hair is styled to frame her face and head under the crown. She is flanked by two other female figures; the one on the left wears a hat with flowing ribbons and a similarly styled dress, while the figure on the right wears a detailed robe with a belted waist and holds a musical instrument. There is a partial figure visible behind these three, who also wears elaborate attire. In the background, an architectural structure featuring arches and decorative elements is visible, and behind it are trees and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Annunciation to Zacharias
artworks.description: This painting shows a man standing with his hands on his chest, looking up and to the right. A golden object hangs from one of his hands. He is wearing a white robe with black and gold trim and a pointed white hat. The man has pale skin, long gray hair, and a long gray beard. He is looking upward with a slight smile, and there is a golden halo around his head. He stands next to an ornately decorated blue table covered with a patterned white cloth. Above the man, near the top right corner of the room, there is a small person in blue robes with blue wings who hovers in the air, pointing downward towards the man. This person has pale skin and blond hair, and they also have a golden halo. The background features a domed gray ceiling with decorative red arch motifs. The painting is framed by decorative borders in gold, blue, and red, with a large cream-colored shape on the right that looks like a large letter I.

artworks.title: Landscape with Brigands (Scène de brigands)
artworks.description: The image is a landscape etching portraying a scene from an elevated point of view. The terrain stretches toward a mountainous background with the horizon placed high. Three figures are engaged in discussion beneath a tall palm tree on the left side. The etching showcases detailed line work with hatching for shadows and texture in vegetation and mountains. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia or dark brown ink against a cream background, highlighting contrasts and texture in the landscape.

artworks.title: Triumphal Procession of Bacchus
artworks.medium: engraving and punch engraving, retouched with black ink, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a circular design. The artwork features a ring of detailed, decorative motifs around a central empty circle surrounded by an ornate band. The band includes various fantastical and mythological elements such as cherubic figures, animals, and intricate foliage. The figures are dynamically posed, interacting with elements like musical instruments, animals, and mythical scenes. The design is detailed and precise, possibly reminiscent of traditional printmaking techniques.

artworks.title: Bacchus Riding in a Wagon
artworks.medium: engraving and punch engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This shows an intricate radial design with mythological motifs and architectural elements. The image features a circular band filled with detailed drawings of chubby figures, surrounded by various ornate elements including floral and natural motifs, buildings, and countryside landscapes. The centerpiece is an empty circle. The style appears to be influenced by the Renaissance, focusing on balance, symmetry, and classicism in the ornamental elements.

artworks.title: Apollo and Daphne
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene within a circular frame. The viewer has a slightly elevated perspective, showing the horizon, small hills, and a busy town with buildings, towers, and steeples. The illustration is detailed with precise linework, resembling woodcuts or early print techniques. The monochrome color palette uses varying shades of black and white. A figure in classical attire is seen moving towards a tree with a human-like form. The background shows a complex townscape, hills, and swirling clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Apollo Pursuing Daphne
artworks.description: The image features a circular composition showcasing a pastoral landscape. Two figures are shown in the foreground, one holding a bow, while the other is engaged in a different activity. In the background, a town with various buildings and a tall tree is depicted. Rolling hills with additional structures lead up to the horizon. The sky is filled with clouds, adding movement to the scene. The artwork is monochromatic, focusing on line work and detail. The style is intricate and detailed, with precise lines and shading highlighting the architecture and landscape.

artworks.title: The Jack of Parrots
artworks.description: The image depicts a stylized humanoid figure interacting with a bird. The figure is shown in dynamic motion, holding a pole and a flail. Details include muscular features, a headband, and patterned clothing. The composition is circular, framing the scene with a central focus on the figure. In the background, a bird is perched on a stick. The landscape includes rocks and grass tufts.

artworks.title: Saint Dominic
artworks.medium: engraving with hand coloring on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of religious symbolism. The image features a central figure surrounded by various symbols and scrolls. The central figure is holding a crucifix and a rosary, and is encircled by other robed figures, each with a halo. The background shows tree branches and vines, with a lamb resting next to a globe and other symbolic objects at the base of a central trunk. Latin text is present on the scrolls and figures. The colors are muted, with earth tones and soft reds and greens. The style is reminiscent of medieval or early Renaissance artwork with elements of woodcut or early printmaking, characterized by strong outlines and hand coloring.

artworks.title: Saint Susanna
artworks.artist: Matteo di ser Cambio di Bettolo
artworks.description: The image depicts an individual standing at the center. They are standing upright with their head slightly turned, gazing outward. Their expression is serene with soft features and short, wavy, light-colored hair. They wear a red robe with gold trim over a green undergarment. They have a halo above their head. They hold a sheaf of wheat. The background shows an architectural setting with a tall pale structure, two towers, and an arched doorway filled with a blue swirling pattern. Decorative patterns in green and gold adorn the borders.

artworks.title: Saint James
artworks.artist: Matteo di ser Cambio di Bettolo
artworks.description: The image displays a full-length depiction of a person with a halo around their head, brown hair, and defined facial features. The individual is standing upright, dressed in a blue robe with a cream-white cloak draped over it. They hold a staff in one hand and a book in the other. The setting includes an ornate architectural structure resembling a stone portal with a red and blue patterned background. The border of the image is adorned with colorful geometric designs in blue, red, and green hues.

artworks.title: Title Page: Large Pendant, Venus and Amor at Centre
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate design with elaborate curves, ornate lines, and symmetrical shapes creating a complex and abstract pattern. At the center is a figure resembling a classical sculpture surrounded by mythical creatures and decorative elements like winged horses and floral motifs. The design is reminiscent of baroque ornamental style, presenting a richly detailed visual narrative.

artworks.title: Large Strapwork Pendant with Two Hangers as Earrings at Left and Right
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental design. The image showcases a symmetrical composition with swirling, vine-like patterns around a central axis. The intricate design includes teardrop-shaped elements at the bottom and ribbon-like forms at the top, implying movement. The detailed line work and shading add depth to the design, featuring motifs similar to gothic or renaissance art styles.

artworks.title: Large Pendant with Star at Centre
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate, symmetrical ornamental design. The image includes a detailed arrangement of geometric shapes and patterns. The primary feature is a central circular motif composed of radiating, spoke-like elements surrounded by rectangular and diamond-shaped forms, with smaller circular shapes and decorative flourishes extending outward. There are small suspended elements at the bottom. Fine lines and shading techniques create a three-dimensional effect.

artworks.title: Large Pendant, Three Nude Women with Twigs  at Centre
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate symmetrical design. The full-description depicts a highly detailed ornamental composition centered around a rectangular frame filled with depictions of mythological figures and decorative motifs. At the top, a ribbon with tassels elegantly drapes above the frame. Within the frame, at the top center, a figure is depicted standing, surrounded by ornamental foliage and decorative flourishes. Flanking this central figure, smaller figures are positioned symmetrically, adding to the harmonious balance of the design. Various elements such as blooms, urns, and swirling vines create a sense of abundance and elaboration. The piece is a celebration of classical ornamentation, reflecting a style that is meticulous in its detailing and harmonious in its layout.

artworks.title: Strapwork Pendant with Two Birds as Earrings at Left and Right
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, symmetrical ornamental pendant design. The central design is detailed with symmetrical scrollwork and flourishes. The ornament is topped by a ribbon bow and is decorated with swirling ribbons on either side. Hanging from the central design are three decorative drops, each ending in a small, oval shape. Below two of these drops are perched birds, each holding a small ornament that matches the form of the central pendants. The drawing showcases a meticulous attention to detail, with fine lines and stippling techniques used to convey depth and texture. Overall, the image exhibits a highly ornamental and baroque style, with a focus on symmetry and intricate detailing.

artworks.title: Large Pendant with Two Double Crosses, Surrounded by Six Large and Sixteen Small Table-Stones
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate ornamental design. The composition features a symmetrical arrangement of geometric shapes and floral motifs forming an elaborate pendant or piece of jewelry. The central portion is a star-shaped design comprised of small squares and rectangles, surrounded by decorative scrollwork and embellishments reminiscent of gemstones or ornate metalwork. At the bottom, there are hangings resembling drops or ornamental beads. Suspended on either side, small bird-like figures are present, each holding a spherical object. Above the main design, ribbon-like shapes are curling and extending, adding to the decorative aspect. The fine detailing and structured symmetry suggest a design intended for ornamental or architectural significance.

artworks.title: Large Pendant, Flora Standing, Holding a Fruit Garland
artworks.description: The image depicts a complex pattern of intricate lines and symmetrical shapes, forming an abstract circular design. In the center, there is a figure resembling a human form surrounded by various elements resembling birds, rabbits, and ornamental floral motifs. Two ribbon-like shapes loop and twist above the circle, while below, two intricately rendered baskets filled with foliage and fruit are depicted. The overall composition comprises an elaborate abstract design imbued with decorative flair.

artworks.title: Strapwork Pendant with Two Eagles as Earringsat Left and Right
artworks.description: The image depicts a highly detailed abstract design featuring curving and swirling lines that create a symmetrical and balanced pattern. The design may invoke images of an ornamental chandelier or decorative emblem with intricate scrollwork. Ribbon-like shapes flow at the top, while a central motif resembles a stylized crown or crest. Teardrop-shaped pendants hang at the bottom, giving the impression of grandiose jewelry. Small bird-like figures are placed at either side, adding to the ornate appearance of the design.

artworks.title: Large Pendant in the Form of a Wheel
artworks.description: The image contains a central circular motif surrounded by various intricate patterns and ornaments, displaying a symmetrical composition. Abstract curling and swirling lines create an ornate frame around a star-like form in the center. Rectangular shapes placed at intervals mimic gemstones, while the overall symmetry and embellishments bring to mind an intricate piece of jewelry or an elaborate brooch. Curved ribbons extend outward from the center, accompanied by pendant-like drops resembling teardrop jewels, adding complexity to the design.

artworks.title: Large Pendant, Victory Flanked by Two Herms at Centre
artworks.description: The image shows a central composition of intricate lines and symmetrical shapes forming a complex abstract pattern. The design includes stylized human figures and floral motifs resembling a decorative piece, with bow-like elements cascading on either side. There are mythical creatures resembling winged dragons at the base, adding an ornamental touch.

artworks.title: Strapwork Pendant with Two Swans as Earrings at Left and Right
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate ornamental design. The artwork features an intricate symmetrical pattern resembling ornate metalwork or filigree. The central motif is composed of curvaceous, leaf-like decorations intertwined with geometric shapes and scrollwork. Styled ribbons with tassels snake gracefully around the design. Below the central structure, hanging pendants or egg-shaped ornaments add to the decorative complexity. At the sides, swan-shaped ornaments hang from the structure. The piece seems to fuse architectural elements with decorative art.

artworks.title: Large Pendant
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate pendant or jewelry design. The design features a central starburst motif with sharp, geometric forms radiating from a circular center. This starburst is intricately connected to other geometric shapes and floral details. Below this central motif, a cross shape is integrated into the pattern, flanked by symmetrical decorative elements. Three pear-shaped forms hang elegantly. The arrangement is adorned with flowing ribbon-like forms that extend across the composition.
